idea-plugin.name: Maven Up
idea-plugin.description:
Find and fix vulnerable Maven dependencies — and keep every dependency, plugin, and parent POM up to date from one tool window.

Core Features:

  • Find & Update Versions: Discover newer versions in Maven Central and private repositories, apply configurable auto-selection strategies, and bulk-update dependencies, plugins, and parent POMs directly from the tool window.
  • Vulnerability Scanning: Check dependencies, plugins, and resolved transitive components for known vulnerabilities via OSV.dev and Sonatype OSS Index with severity ratings, CVSS scores, and affected version ranges.
  • One-Click Vulnerability Fixes: Apply recommended fix versions for direct findings and pin vulnerable transitive dependencies in dependencyManagement with configurable explanatory comments.
  • Complete Dependency Overview: Displays all dependencies, plugins, and parent POMs across Maven modules in an organized table, marking entries inherited from parent POMs or BOM imports.
  • Transitive Vulnerabilities View: Inspect, filter, and remediate vulnerable transitive dependencies in a dedicated tool window tab with highlighted recommended fix versions.

Advanced Capabilities:

  • Property-Aware Versions: Recognizes and updates Maven properties (e.g., ${spring.version}) across all references while resolving placeholders accurately.
  • Dependency Hierarchy Inspection: Inspect searchable parent, BOM, management, and inclusion paths in a side panel, initially expanding table and CVE paths while keeping unreferenced transitive-only context available on demand, with an option to show or hide GroupIds.
  • Detailed Security Reports: View advisories in a master-detail split view with severity, CVSS scores and vectors, CWE identifiers, affected version ranges, fixed versions, and advisory references.
  • Safe Update Workflow: Review all planned version updates and managed-entry removals in a sortable confirmation dialog with optional automatic Maven re-sync.
  • Flexible Filtering & Sorting: Filter by name, type, inheritance, pending updates, or security findings, and sort columns ascending, descending, or in original POM order.
  • Status at a Glance: Marks the tool window icon with a colored badge dot to signal vulnerabilities and available updates while the tool window is collapsed.
  • Smart Navigation: Jump directly to pom.xml declarations or property definitions, and open artifacts in configured repository browsers with a single click.
  • Private Repository Support: Access authenticated repositories from Maven settings.xml with support for environment variable placeholders.
  • Private GroupId Filter: Exclude internal GroupIds from Maven Central queries to ensure proprietary company identifiers remain private.
  • Optional Downgrades & Version Filtering: List older versions when rollbacks are needed or hide unstable releases and custom pre-release qualifiers.
  • Repository Browser Options: Choose between MVN Repository and Sonatype Central for artifact links.
  • Transparent Error Handling: Report failed API or repository requests in closable banners with direct links to settings when credentials require attention.
  • Secure Token Storage: Stores Sonatype OSS Index API tokens safely in IntelliJ Password Safe.
  • Global Settings: Configure version lookup strategies, vulnerability scanners, and POM modification preferences under Settings | Tools | Maven Up.
  • Privacy-First Design: Only Maven coordinates are transmitted over HTTPS for version checks and vulnerability scans—your source code remains private.
  • Reliable Plugin Lifecycle: Requires an IDE restart after installing, updating, or disabling the plugin.
